name: Runner Extras - UserSecurityId identity
brief: Pins that UserSecurityId() returns one stable, non-empty GUID everywhere it is read.
description: AL keys per-user singleton tables on UserSecurityId(). If the runner answers that function with two different values depending on the call context — or with the empty GUID — a row written under one identity becomes unreachable under the other, and the failure surfaces far away as 'the <table> does not exist'.
